reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves Client's freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software/services, with the only limits being non-infringement of TrueLink IP and existing confidentiality obligations — both neutral/favourable to us.

The 'ordinary course of its business of origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables' language is correctly characterised as a scope-of-licence limit on use of the Interface, not a restraint on the businesses Client may operate or the products it may buy or build, so the NONCOMPETE rule is not engaged.

Section 8(d)'s cross-reference to a separate Non-Competition Agreement constrains TrueLink's use of Credit Data (in our favour); the rationale appropriately flags it for separate diligence without treating it as an in-document restraint on Client.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the paragraphs are rendered unchanged; the deterministic check (no open-ended compete restriction on Customer) also passes.
